title: AtlantMC
description: A vanilla+ Minecraft modpack focused on visuals, animations, and world generation while still keeping the classic survival feel.
body:
Enhance your Minecraft adventure with a carefully crafted Vanilla+ experience focused on immersion, exploration, and atmosphere. This modpack upgrades the game with stunning world generation, beautiful new biomes, improved animations, dynamic visuals, ambient audio, and modern quality-of-life features — while preserving the original Minecraft gameplay you already love.

Travel through breathtaking landscapes, discover more detailed environments, enjoy smoother player and creature animations, and experience a world that feels more alive and cinematic. Every mod is selected to blend naturally with vanilla Minecraft, creating a polished and optimized experience without overwhelming the core survival progression.

## ✨ Features:

Beautiful new biomes and enhanced terrain generation
Improved player, mob, and environmental animations
Better lighting, particles, and immersive visuals
Atmospheric ambient sounds and music enhancements
Vanilla-friendly gameplay and progression
Performance and quality-of-life improvements
Multiplayer compatible

Perfect for players who want Minecraft to feel more modern, immersive, and visually stunning while staying true to the vanilla spirit.
